description: A list and a tuple of another length unify to a list
notes: The spec unifies a list and a tuple to the tuple type, and converting a list to a tuple of a different length is an error, so this should fail. go-cty has no conversion from a list or set to a tuple at all; hashicorp/hcl unifies to a list instead (unifyTuplesAsList in cty/convert/unify.go) and returns the one-element list.
